title: Juniper and the Vector
author: C. M. Zhou
blurb: Jude Amberdale, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
